buildcraft:fragile_fluid_shard.excluded: NBT item: a shard only holds the fluid a broken machine or pipe dropped, and a blank shard holds nothing and cannot be filled. Transmutation never copies NBT, so a value could only be paid out for an empty, useless shard.

buildcraft:frame.excluded: Creative-only: the quarry builds its frame from power, frame blocks drop nothing, and there is no frame recipe, so a value would only make creative frames transmutable.

Leaving residue unvalued also keeps the residue-to-waterproof recipe from pricing waterproof.
